source_concurrency_reason: Redshift Serverless workgroup demo-wg is shared; every federated query counts against this cap

source_access.degraded_fallback: snapshot from customer exports (--mode snapshot) only under a new plan decision

DECIMAL.note: order_total DECIMAL(12,2), unit_price DECIMAL(10,2), discount_pct DECIMAL(5,4)

CHAR.note: CHAR(10) order_status and CHAR(4) region are blank-padded on Redshift; 'CANCELLED  ' compares after rstrip

mart.populations: all rows; daily_revenue excludes the current day per sql/etl/10_build_daily_revenue.sql

nondeterminism.GETDATE_cutoff: mart.daily_revenue filters order_ts < TRUNC(GETDATE()); recon compares both sides for the same as-of date
nondeterminism.AVG_of_averages: sql/reports/20_region_topline.sql averages avg_order_value; graded as an aggregate under aggregate_rel_tol

amendment_procedure: Only a new `important` plan decision selected by the human may change a value. An amendment appends a row to `amendments` ({decision, changed, from, to, re_verification_scope}); the old value is never edited in place and the row names the units that must be re-verified.
